title: Fraud Control-Sr. Executive-Ahmedabad
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a **Fraud Control Analyst** to identify, investigate and prevent activities that could result in financial loss or a poor customer experience. Based in **India or the EU** and reporting to a Team Leader within Security Operations, you will monitor customer activity, analyse suspected fraud cases and take timely decisions to prevent fraudulent activity.

This opportunity is suited to candidates with **3–5 years of experience in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or customer support**, particularly where data analysis has been an important part of the role. The position operates in a **24/7 environment**.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Monitor customer accounts, services and transactions to identify potentially fraudulent or suspicious activity, including roaming, domestic, artificially inflated traffic and first-party fraud.
* Conduct detailed investigations of identified fraud-risk cases and use available evidence to confirm or rule out fraudulent activity.
* Monitor accounts with unusually high local or international voice, messaging or data usage and take appropriate preventive action in line with established procedures.
* Identify emerging fraud patterns and recommend effective approaches for fraud prevention, detection and resolution.
* Manage internal fraud-related requests and complaints received through phone and email while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Make timely, evidence-based decisions to prevent fraudulent activity, including independently resolving complex cases within established processes.
* Maintain accurate case handling and meet agreed productivity, quality, service-level and process-compliance requirements.
* Contribute to performance reporting, including key performance indicators and service delivery standards.
* Collaborate professionally with colleagues, Team Leaders and other stakeholders, and recommend opportunities to improve fraud-control processes.
* Comply with applicable internal regulations, departmental procedures and the Code of Conduct.

Success in the role will be measured primarily through the **speed and effectiveness of fraud prevention, accuracy of decisions and adherence to required processes**.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You are a graduate from a recognised university with **3–5 years of relevant experience** in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or a customer support role involving data analysis.
* You have strong analytical skills and knowledge of **telecommunications or banking fraud-control practices**, with the judgement to investigate complex information and make appropriate decisions.
* You are comfortable using **Microsoft Office and multiple systems or applications** to analyse information and manage cases.
* You have strong written and verbal English communication skills at approximately **C1/C2 proficiency** and can manage customer and internal interactions professionally, including challenging situations.
* You are organised, customer-focused and results-oriented, can prioritise competing activities, proactively manage your performance and are willing to work in a **24/7 operational environment**.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to build practical expertise in **telecommunications fraud detection and prevention**.
* Exposure to customer and transaction monitoring across domestic and international telecommunications services.
* Experience investigating complex fraud-risk cases where decisions directly contribute to reducing financial loss and protecting customer experience.
* Opportunity to work collaboratively within Security Operations and contribute recommendations that improve fraud-control processes and service delivery.
* A role offering meaningful decision-making responsibility and exposure to evolving fraud behaviours and prevention approaches.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced fraud-risk analysis and investigation techniques within a telecommunications environment.
* Identification and interpretation of emerging fraud behaviours and suspicious usage patterns.
* Evidence-based decision-making for fraud prevention and loss mitigation.
* Monitoring and interpretation of operational performance measures, including quality, service standards and fraud-prevention effectiveness.
* Cross-functional communication, customer issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

**Alert**
---------

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  
#JDEnhancedByTARA

**Follow us on social media**
-----------------------------

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vois/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/voisglobal

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/voisglobal/

title: ZY IT - Regulatory Data Migration Analyst
description:
Join **Zydus Corporate IT** as a **Regulatory Information Management (RIMS) Analyst** and play a key role in enabling regulatory data transformation and migration initiatives across global markets.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

As part of the Regulatory Information Management System (RIMS) build-out at Zydus, Regulatory Affairs (RA) data including product registrations, submissions, licenses, and health authority correspondence needs to be accurately migrated from legacy systems into the new RIMS platform, ArisGlobal.

The RIMS Tech Ops role is a hands-on position responsible for building and maintaining data templates used for RA data migration and managing day-to-day migration activities and issues. The role requires execution of migration activities in line with defined standards, timelines, and quality requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and maintain data templates for RA data migration into the RIMS platform based on defined standards and designs.
* Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and loading (ETL) of regulatory data from legacy sources into the RIMS platform.
* Execute data mapping from legacy systems and formats to the RIMS platform data model, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day data migration issues, discrepancies, and defects.
* Perform data quality checks and validation against defined standards prior to migration sign-off.
* Coordinate with Regulatory Affairs users and business stakeholders to validate migrated data and resolve data-related queries.
* Document data mapping specifications, migration procedures, and issue logs to support traceability and knowledge continuity.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles for migrated data, capturing and resolving feedback from business stakeholders.
* Escalate systemic issues, data quality gaps, or template/design limitations to cross-functional teams for resolution.
* Maintain migration trackers and status reports for ongoing migration activities.
* Ensure migration work adheres to data privacy, security, GxP, CSV, and regulatory compliance requirements applicable to a regulated environment.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 3-7 years of experience, including at least 2 years in Regulatory Affairs (RA) operations, regulatory submissions, RIMS data management, or GxP data migration.
* Understanding of regulatory data structures, including products, registrations, licenses, submissions, variations, and renewals.
* Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of SQL for data cleansing, mapping, reconciliation, and validation activities.
* Working knowledge of GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), and data integrity requirements.
* Preferred experience with ArisGlobal bulk-load tools and/or Python scripting.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to work effectively with Regulatory Affairs teams across multiple markets.

title: IT Support & Cybersecurity Analyst
description:

title: Security Consultant
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform VAPT engagements for web applications, APIs, mobile applications, internal and external networks, and cloud environments.
* Identify, validate, and assess vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and business logic flaws.
* Prepare detailed assessment reports with technical findings, proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings, business impact, and remediation recommendations.
* Communicate vulnerabilities and associated risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* To perform remediation validation and re-testing to confirm the closure of identified issues.
* Stay updated with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and current security trends.

**Technical Skills** :

* Strong understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, routing, switching, VPNs, and firewalls
* Good knowledge of Operating Systems:o Linux (File system, Permissions, Basic commands) o Windows (Architecture, services, Registry basics)
* Strong understanding of web, mobile (Android/IOS) and API application architecture and security concepts.
* Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms including sessions, cookies, JWT, OAuth, and SSO.
* Understanding of common attack vectors such as XSS, SQL injection, SSRF, CSRF, and IDOR.
* Understanding of REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and modern API architectures.
* Hands-on experience identifying vulnerabilities aligned with the OWASP Top 10 & SANS 25.
* Hands-on experience with tools: Burp Suite, Nessus, Metasploit, SQLmap, Postman, MobSF
* Strong knowledge in leveraging AI to automate VAPT processes and support security research and exploration.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify and resolve issues by understanding the client's environment.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to think like an attacker while maintaining a risk-based approach.  Strong technical documentation and report-writing skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality assessments.
* Ability to manage multiple engagements and meet project deadlines.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies, attack techniques, and security methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Education o Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 1-4 years of hands-on experience in VAPT, Application Security, Offensive Security, or related cybersecurity domains. Internship, freelance, bug bounty, research, or lab-based experience will be considered valuable.

**Required Skills**

* Web VAPT
* Mobile VAPT
* API VAPT
* Network VA

**Certifications (Preferred / Added Advantage**)

* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* eJPT (eLearnSecurity Junior Penetration Tester)
* BSCP (Burp Suite Certified Practitioner)
* CompTIA Security+  PNPT (Practical Network Penetration Tester)
* CJCA (Certified Junior Cybersecurity Analyst)
* eCPPT (eLearnSecurity Certified Professional Penetration Tester)
* CPTS (Certified Penetration Testing Specialist)  OSCP / OSCP+ (Offensive Security Certified Professional)

**Important:** This hiring is strictly for experienced full-time professionals. Freshers and internship candidates are not eligible.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**Job description:**

InvestMentor Securities Ltd. is a fast-growing and leading full-service stock broker in Gujarat. Supported by experienced research analysts, the company offers in-depth market analysis and research reports. Known for its advanced technology-driven approach, clients can trade conveniently using the user-friendly mobile app from anywhere. With a strong commitment to customer satisfaction, the company has established itself as a trusted name in the stock-broking industry, building a loyal client base.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Equity Research Analyst with strong market understanding and analytical capabilities. The candidate will conduct in-depth analysis of stocks, sectors, derivatives and market trends, and provide actionable insights to drive investment decisions. The role also involves preparing research reports, creating content for investors, and engaging in client-facing communication.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct thorough research on stocks, sectors, F&O, and market trends.
* Analyses financial statements, balance sheets, sector data, market information, and economic indicators.
* Develop financial models and perform valuation analysis using industry-standard methods.
* Create and publish research reports, market insights, and investment recommendations.
* Prepare presentations, daily/weekly outlook reports, and investment cases.
* Stay updated with industry developments, global markets, and new research methodologies.
* Collaborate with the in-house research and advisory team on strategy building.
* Be comfortable in **making educational videos, daily market insights, and hosting webinars** for clients.
* Work with **algo strategy builders & third-party algo vendors**, and provide inputs for strategy development & back-testing.
* Track derivatives data (OI, PCR, rollovers, IV) and use it in market interpretation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, MBA, or a related field.
* Proven work experience in equity research, brokerage, wealth management, or investment banking.
* **Strong knowledge of F&O markets, derivatives, technical and fundamental analysis.**
* Experience working with **algo strategy builders / third-party algo vendors** (e.g., Tradetron, Algotest, Quantower, etc.)
* Ability to analyse and interpret charts, OI data, volume, and price action.
* Excellent analytical and communication skills — **must be comfortable speaking on camera and conducting webinars.**

· **Note**: NISM-Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives & NISM-Series-XV; Research Analyst Certification is MANDOTARY

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Experience:**

* Equity research: 1 year (Required)

**Location:**

* Ashram Road P.O, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Required)

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently based in Ahmedabad
* Do you have at least 1 year of professional experience in equity research, with strong knowledge of F&O, derivatives, technical analysis, and fundamental analysis?
* Do you hold both NISM-Series-VIII (Equity Derivatives) and NISM-Series-XV (Research Analyst) certifications?
